proposals.defect: The sticky start route index is ignored when computing the attempt order, so the next request after a successful fallback does not begin from the route that most recently succeeded.

The sticky start index is passed only for the first request and is replaced by the request index afterwards. Because of this, the start route is chosen by the request counter instead of the route that most recently succeeded.
